COORDINATOR.firewall: market_overlay() takes the frozen forecast as an argument and returns a separate object. There is no call path by which a price reaches v13_sim — market independence as a call graph, not a promise.
COORDINATOR.order: schedule -> enrich -> FREEZE FEATURES -> forecast -> register -> market overlay

true_no_forecast_is_reserved.enforcement: assert_mathematical() RAISES ForecastSuppressed on any rejected reason, so a future caller cannot record one without editing the list in the same commit

GRADE_OF_THIS_EXERCISE.what_would_make_it_prospective: running the coordinator before first pitch and freezing the board, which is what it now exists to do
GRADE_OF_THIS_EXERCISE.why: the inputs are all pregame-dated — the relay capture, the pitcher registry, team form through the cutoff — but I RAN the engine after the games were played and while knowing the outcomes. This demonstrates what the pipeline WOULD have produced. It is not a prospective forecast and accrues NOTHING to settlement, promotion or the estimator.

INVARIANT_ADOPTED: NO_ACTION != NO_FORECAST. Every canonically scheduled MLB game receives a registered forecast unless the PREDICTION ENGINE ITSELF cannot execute.

PARSER.cross_check: every parsed current ML equals the value the board itself recorded; the four total moves it derives (BOS@NYY, PHI@LAA, PIT@STL 8.5->8.0; HOU@NYM 8.5->9.0) match the board's own movement notes
PARSER.result: 14/14 games, 14/14 starter pairs, 14/14 markets, ZERO parse problems
PARSER.why_deterministic: a 4,461-line artifact is exactly where 'I read it' and 'I extracted it' diverge. The DK Open column is genuinely ambiguous — the FAVOURITE's row carries an opening moneyline and the underdog's an opening total — so the parser detects the literal ML token rather than assuming away-or-home, and refuses fields it cannot read unambiguously.

REGRESSION_RESULT.schedule_reconciliation: ARI@SF was absent from the sportsbook board. It is RETAINED as a scheduled game, forecast at p_home 0.4658, and marked NO_LINE — not dropped, and not confused with a game that could not be modelled.

WHAT_THE_MODEL_WOULD_HAVE_PROJECTED.honest_read: the model did NOT beat the market. It won one the market lost (BOS@NYY: model NYY .5274, market had BOS) and lost three the market won (CWS@MIN, HOU@NYM, MIA@WSH). At n=13 this settles nothing in either direction.

refused_finals.COL@ATL: source returned a 2-2 tie, impossible in an MLB regular-season game

WHAT_WAS_ACTUALLY_AVAILABLE.conclusion: the engine could have executed fifteen times and executed zero

WHY_THAT_REASON_COULD_NEVER_BE_SATISFIED.consequence: a board evaluated at 08:15 ET is tested against a condition that cannot exist until after first pitch. Not 'usually fails' — CANNOT be satisfied. Every pregame MLB board is CLV_ONLY by construction, permanently.
WHY_THAT_REASON_COULD_NEVER_BE_SATISFIED.rule_verbatim: feed_mlb_statsapi: 'NEVER mint CONFIRMED from a probable. Confirmation requires the boxscore to show the game past first pitch' and confirmed_starter_or_probable: 'never promoted, whatever its freshness'.
WHY_THAT_REASON_COULD_NEVER_BE_SATISFIED.verdict: a dead branch reported as an information problem
